name: lyrics_render
description: Render a lyrics video by burning caption track text onto a background using ffmpeg drawtext. Word-by-word accumulation: each word reveals and the line grows until the phrase ends. Outputs an MP4 with captions baked in.

input.description: Optional background video to loop. If omitted, a solid color background is used.

output.description: MP4 with captions rendered onto background

params.name: captions
params.description: Path to caption track JSON from lyrics_sync or caption step

params.name: bg-color
params.description: Background color when no input video is provided (default: black)

params.name: color
params.description: Caption text color, or 'auto' to detect from video (default: auto)

params.name: position
params.description: Caption position: center, top-left, or bottom-left (default: center)

params.name: duration
params.description: Output duration in seconds (overrides full audio duration)

params.name: preview-duration
params.description: Only render this many seconds — useful for quick previews (overrides duration)

params.name: box
params.description: Draw a semi-transparent box behind caption text

params.name: accumulate
params.description: Accumulate all words so far; default is word-by-word

params.name: window-size
params.description: Sliding window: show last N words, one per line (default: 1)

params.name: words-per-line
params.description: Show full segment at once, N words per line (default: 3)

params.name: audio-inpoint
params.description: Seek position in the audio file (seconds). Overrides audioInPoint in captions JSON for the ffmpeg seek.
